about: 판매일괄회계반영 서버(원본 E040215 2026-10-22 2차 재기): 같은 거래처 판매 2건(10 x 1,000 · 8 x 1,000) → [매출전표 I] 한 번에 전표 1장 19,800 → 한 건 반영취소하면 둘 다 미반영 → 판매 줄 단위(5 + 3 줄 중 2번째 줄만 공급가 3,000 → 2,000 으로 고쳐 반영 = 2,200, 남은 줄 5,000) → 일부 줄 반영된 판매는 수정 막힘 → 매출전표포함 삭제로 정리.

shots.name: 묶음 회계전표 · 줄 단위 반영 (API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:Promise.all(['/items','/warehouses','/partners'].map((p) => window.__api('GET', p))).then(async ([it, wh, pa]) => { const i = it.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-PROD'), w = wh.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-WH') ?? wh.body[0], c = pa.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-CUST'); const d = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); await window.__api('POST', '/stock/transactions', { itemId: i.id, warehouseId: w.id, type: 'INBOUND', quantity: 30, remark: 'QA재고1c' }); const mk = (lines) => window.__api('POST', '/sales', { saleDate: d, partnerId: c.id, warehouseId: w.id, remark: 'QA재고1c', lines }).then((r) => r.body); const a = await mk([{ itemId: i.id, quantity: 10, unitPrice: 1000 }]); const b = await mk([{ itemId: i.id, quantity: 8, unitPrice: 1000 }]); const e = await mk([{ itemId: i.id, quantity: 5, unitPrice: 1000 }, { itemId: i.id, quantity: 3, unitPrice: 1000 }]); sessionStorage.setItem('sbr', JSON.stringify({ pid: c.id, itemId: i.id, whId: w.id, a: a.id, b: b.id, e: e.id, eLines: e.lines.map((l) => l.id) })); return true })

js:(() => { const s = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sbr')); return window.__api('POST', '/accounting-reflection/reflect-sales-batch', { salesIds: [s.a, s.b], vatType: '세금계산서' }).then(async (r) => { const j = r.status === 200 ? await window.__api('GET', '/journals/' + r.body.journalEntryId) : null; const all = (await window.__api('GET', '/accounting-reflection?kind=SALES')).body; const mine = all.filter((x) => [s.a, s.b].includes(x.id)); sessionStorage.setItem('sbrR', JSON.stringify({ st: r.status, n: r.body?.salesCount, debit: j?.body?.totalDebit, same: new Set(mine.map((x) => x.journalEntryId)).size, refl: mine.every((x) => x.reflected), src: j?.body?.sourceType })); return true }) })()
expect:(() => { const r = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sbrR')); return r.st === 200 && r.n === 2 && Number(r.debit) === 19800 && r.same === 1 && r.refl && r.src === 'SALES_BATCH' })()

js:(() => { const s = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sbr')); return window.__api('POST', '/accounting-reflection/unreflect', { kind: 'SALES', ids: [s.a] }).then(async () => { const all = (await window.__api('GET', '/accounting-reflection?kind=SALES')).body; sessionStorage.setItem('sbrU', JSON.stringify(all.filter((x) => [s.a, s.b].includes(x.id)).map((x) => x.reflected))); return true }) })()

js:(() => { const s = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sbr')); return window.__api('POST', '/accounting-reflection/reflect-sales-batch', { salesIds: [s.e], lineIds: [s.eLines[1]], supplyAmount: 2000, vatType: '세금계산서', note: 'QA재고1c 부분' }).then(async (r) => { const j = r.status === 200 ? await window.__api('GET', '/journals/' + r.body.journalEntryId) : null; const rest = (await window.__api('GET', '/accounting-reflection?kind=SALES&onlyUnreflected=true')).body.find((x) => x.id === s.e); sessionStorage.setItem('sbrL', JSON.stringify({ st: r.status, debit: j?.body?.totalDebit, lines: r.body?.lineCount, restSupply: rest?.supplyAmount, restLines: rest?.lines?.length, edit: (await window.__api('PUT', '/sales/' + s.e, { partnerId: s.pid, warehouseId: s.whId, lines: [{ itemId: s.itemId, quantity: 1, unitPrice: 1000 }] })).status })); return true }) })()

expect:(() => { const r = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sbrL')); return r.st === 200 && Number(r.debit) === 2200 && r.lines === 1 && Number(r.restSupply) === 5000 && r.restLines === 1 && r.edit === 400 })()

js:(() => { const s = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sbr')); return window.__api('POST', '/accounting-reflection/delete-sales-with-journal', { kind: 'SALES', ids: [s.a, s.b, s.e] }).then(async (r) => { const left = (await window.__api('GET', '/accounting-reflection?kind=SALES')).body.filter((x) => [s.a, s.b, s.e].includes(x.id)).length; sessionStorage.setItem('sbrD', JSON.stringify({ st: r.status, left })); return window.__api('POST', '/stock/transactions', { itemId: s.itemId, warehouseId: s.whId, type: 'OUTBOUND', quantity: 30, remark: 'QA재고1c 되돌림' }).then(() => true) }) })()
expect:(() => { const r = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sbrD')); return r.st === 200 && r.left === 0 })()
